description:
Turn one ring. Align three petals. Bloom the garden before your moves run out.

Ringbloom is a calm, one-thumb rotational puzzle with two distinct ways to play: the original endless Garden and the handcrafted Flower Show. Choose the inner, middle, or outer ring, turn it one notch left or right, and line up matching petals across a spoke. Six simple choices create a surprising amount of strategy.

TAKE ON THE FLOWER SHOW
Master a focused 30-Class puzzle campaign where every Class changes the objective. Build Ring Harmony, preserve Unbroken chains, contain spreading Bindweed, create Twin Blooms, assemble Prize Bouquets and meet the judges’ exact orders. Each Class is a compact tactical challenge with a clear goal and a best rating to pursue.

BECOME GRAND CHAMPION
Reach the Grand Final, earn the Grand Champion result, then continue through the Champion Circuit. The Circuit draws from a certified catalogue of curated rule combinations for an enduring post-campaign challenge.

TRACK EVERY RESULT
The Class Book records your progress and best rating across the whole Show. Replay completed Classes, replace saved attempts only when you improve, and pursue a Perfect Show without losing stronger results.

LEARN THE RULES AS THEY ARRIVE
Each new rule is introduced in play, with live objective status and exact wording for what remains. Exact Hint and Undo are available when you need them, with their rating consequences shown clearly before you commit. Bindweed previews where it will spread so difficult choices stay readable.

KEEP GROWING IN GARDEN
The original endless Garden remains a calm, steadily growing challenge. Bloom on consecutive turns to build chains, align several spokes for bigger combos, and earn a one-to-three-spark rating before your moves run out.

STOP WHENEVER YOU LIKE
Pause or return home at any time. Ringbloom saves your precise progress on-device, including your active board, Class or Garden state, scores, ratings and remaining assists.

DESIGNED FOR MORE PLAYERS
• Direct one-thumb swipes plus large, labelled ring and turn controls
• A distinct glyph for every colour, so colour is never the only cue
• VoiceOver summaries and announcements
• Larger Text layouts and Reduce Motion support
• Independent sound and haptic controls

A COMPLETE PREMIUM GAME
Pay once. No ads, energy, in-app purchases, subscription, account, tracking or data collection. Ringbloom plays fully offline.

HOW THIS WAS BUILT
Ringbloom was researched, designed, coded, tested and prepared for the App Store by GPT-5 Codex, an AI system. A human handled Apple’s required account steps and handles the final submission.
promotionalText: Master 30 handcrafted Flower Show Classes, become Grand Champion, then keep playing in the endless Champion Circuit.
whatsNew:
Flower Show has been completely redesigned into a focused 30-Class puzzle campaign, followed by the endless Champion Circuit.

NEW
• Master seven special rules: Ring Harmony, Unbroken, Bindweed, Twin Bloom, Prize Bouquet, Double Harmony and Judges’ Order.
• Track every Class and rating in the new Class Book, replay completed puzzles and pursue a Perfect Show.
• Continue beyond the Grand Final through curated Circuit Classes and a certified endless catalogue.

IMPROVED
• Each Class explains exactly what changed, shows live objectives and keeps your best available rating visible.
• Exact Hint and Undo support make difficult choices clearer without hiding their rating consequences.
• Bindweed previews where it will spread and clearly explains what remains to win.

Garden remains the original calm, endless game. This update changes Flower Show only.
